meta.description: Traditional Georgian / Edwardian round brass doorknob on a 58 mm circular rose. Unified 2D plan, 2D elevation, and 3D mid-poly mesh asset for Element Assembly Studio Pro interior doors.
meta.namingConvention: All custom keys prefixed Na__. Three-stage form Na__Section__SubSection__FieldName.

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks
fieldPrefixes.Na__PanelPlacement__: Door-panel mounting transforms (RH/LH handing, vertical datum)

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: Traditional Georgian/Edwardian 54 mm turned round doorknob on a 58 mm circular rose (62 mm projection). Suits classical six-panel and four-panel single or double interior doors.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: Mid-poly 16-segment closed manifold lathe mesh. Authored lying on back (Z=0 on door face, Z+ outward) matching Na__InteriorDoor__Handle__Default.

Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of rose on door face (spindle). Symmetric left/right.
Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=right, Y=forward (away from door face) | Units=mm | Z discarded

Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of knob spindle. Front view of asset.
Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=right, Y=up | Units=mm | Z discarded

Na__Asset__Mesh3D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0,0 = centre of rose back face on door panel.
Na__Asset__Mesh3D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: Right-handed | X=right, Y=front, Z=up (out of door face) | Units=mm
